title: Quest Race
description: A live class race across a 3D island: Sunny Beach, the Jungle, a smoking volcano, the Sky Bridge and a castle finish. Answer on your device: every right answer is a gem and a dash, three in a row is a BOOST. The big screen is a sports broadcast with a mini track, leader banners, photo finishes and a podium with fireworks. Played alone, it is a practice race against three island racers.
notes: Oomba Live reference game (built-in mode 'quest-race'), on the Oomba Kit 1.1.0 with the dress, bridge-3d and live packs, and the pinned Three.js import map. Game logic, the DOM UI and the 2D view are in a classic script (<meta name="oomba-live" content="2d">); the module adds the 3D view. The server owns scoring and race progress (race events after each reveal); the game derives streaks (3 right in a row = BOOST: flames and a faster dash), overtakes, the leader, the finish order and photo finishes from those updates. Projector: a director camera (lobby orbit, crane to the start, a wide pass while the question is up, chase and side shots while the runners run, slow motion for a photo finish, the podium), broadcast banners, a mini track with every runner, standings, answer counts filling each answer, medals and fireworks; names are left out when the teacher hides them. Phones: a juicy answer pad (sounds, haptics where allowed, bursts), the streak meter, place and gems, encouragement and the right answer after a miss, the race to watch between questions, and an end card. Five zones along the path (the Sky Bridge arches over a lagoon); scenery is instanced and scaled by B.tier, one particle cloud does dust, flames, gem bursts and fireworks; reduced motion keeps the camera still and drops the effects. Solo: an eight-question maths practice race against Bolt, Sunny and Mango with the same banners and a Race again button. Uses Oomba.live: ready({presence, lobby, quiz, hostView, teams}), the question / answers / reveal / result / race / end events, quiz.answer, move (lobby), crowd (3D) and flat (2D). Test hooks: window.__brbTest.state() (also leader, banners, countdown, runners, practice), walk(x, y, ms), answer(i).
